subject.title: fix(android): stop talk mode audio capture on background

question: Should Android continuous TalkMode always stop when the app backgrounds, matching the proposed lifecycle-level voice shutdown?
rationale: The code path is a narrow fix for an active microphone capture problem, but it intentionally changes existing continuous TalkMode behavior and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.
